confirmed: XRP is about $0.96 early Sunday, down about 2.6% over 24 hours and about 17% lower than 7 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot; $0.9640 last trade on Kraken, Kraken 24h range $0.8911 to $0.9974). On Saturday it fell about 10%, its largest one-day percentage loss since Feb 5 (Investing.com), and hit about $0.89, its lowest since November 2024 (CoinDesk). Saturday's close of about $0.91 (CoinGecko) is the lowest daily close since Nov 15, 2024, and below the August 2026 low of about $0.985 (CryptoCompass, Bitstamp data). It has since bounced to about $0.96. 24/7 Wall St found no Ripple-specific news behind the drop; the drivers it documented are market-wide.

Bitcoin fell below $64,000 on Saturday and touched a three-month low just above $62,000 before recovering to about $65,500; it is down about 17% over the week and heading for a sixth straight weekly loss (CoinDesk, Investing.com). US spot bitcoin ETFs have had seven straight sessions of outflows since Nov 5, about $1.7B to $1.9B (Farside via Cointelegraph, SoSoValue via Investing.com). About $1.47B of leveraged positions were liquidated in 24 hours, $1.31B of them longs (CoinGlass via Investing.com). Fed funds futures show about 88.7% odds of a quarter-point hike on Dec 9, and the 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.15% on Nov 13 (24/7 Wall St).

US spot XRP ETFs had a net outflow of about $19.1M for the week of Nov 9 to 13, the largest weekly outflow since March 2026 (SoSoValue via CoinDesk). Friday Nov 13 was −$1.09M (Franklin's XRPZ +$4.45M, Grayscale's GXRP −$5.54M). The last day with net inflows was Oct 29; net assets are about $1.15B and the funds hold about 1.16B to 1.19B XRP a year after the first one launched on Nov 13, 2025 (Bitcoin.com News, TokenPost). ETFs do not trade on weekends, so Saturday's drop is not in these figures yet.

XRP futures open interest has fallen to about $2.21B, a multi-month low, down from about $3.7B in September, and the Crypto Fear and Greed Index is at 18, 'extreme fear' (Benzinga, Nov 14). Lower open interest means less leverage in the market, not necessarily less selling.

On the XRP Ledger, the proposed native lending amendment has 22 of 35 trusted-validator votes and the SingleAssetVault amendment it depends on has 23; each needs 29 held for two straight weeks, so neither is live and there is no activation date (CoinDesk, Nov 12). Separately, XRPL developers will reset Testnet and Devnet from 8 to 9 p.m. ET on Nov 25 after a server failure, wiping test accounts; the main XRP Ledger, real XRP balances and transaction history are not affected (TokenPost, Nov 14).

Binance has reopened withdrawals on 87 networks, including LTC and NEAR, and says it plans to restore all remaining withdrawal services before next weekend (TokenPost, Nov 13). XRP withdrawals were not among the paused tokens in its latest list.

Ripple's Oct 27 partnerships still stand but are mostly plans: BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody, while direct RLUSD mint/redeem at BNY is subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph). Robinhood plans to use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement through Bitstamp and to add RLUSD to its app later in 2026, with no start date or volume announced (Ripple, CryptoSlate).

At Ripple's Swell 2026 event, CEO Brad Garlinghouse said Ripple's large XRP holdings do not give it control of the XRP Ledger: Ripple runs one of the 35 validators on the recommended list, and holding XRP carries no voting weight (DailyCoin, Nov 10). Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz disclosed on Nov 9 and 10 that his own holdings are down from about 26M XRP to about 3M over years of pre-arranged sales (crypto.news); that is a personal disclosure, not a Ripple sale.

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in new escrows, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold. The next release is due Dec 1.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades under $1 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. 'Bank of America announces an official large-scale partnership with Ripple' posts are false: neither company has announced one; BofA's documented link is as a connected bank in Ripple Treasury's (GTreasury) software gateway, not an XRP deal. 'Warren says the CLARITY Act will blow up the economy' recycles a May 2026 committee-hearing quote, not new news. 'Trump XRP payment claims, Nov 22' has no source. 'A $60 trillion bank just said which one it wants, XRP or XLM' is a video teaser with no named bank or document. 'Trump has signed an order opening 401(k)s to crypto' posts this weekend are not new: no new order was signed; the pending step is the Labor Department's final 401(k) alternatives rule, under White House review since Nov 5. '99.5% chance of XRP at $3,300 per coin, insane SEC filing' is a video teaser that names no filing. 'Frustrated XRP investors threatening to sell everything once they break even' is commentary, not data. 'Nearly $83 billion in XRP transfers recorded overnight' posts name no source or on-chain tracker, and follow the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion' posts. 'CNBC calls XRP the hottest crypto trade of the year' clips recycle a Jan 6, 2026 CNBC Power Lunch segment, when XRP was near $2.40. 'Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed Chair' is old news: he took office May 22, 2026. 'Fed XRP settlement testing' and '20% XRP burn' claims have no source. 'Former Ripple employee says this is where millionaires are made' names no one. 'ETF clients buy $3 million of XRP, bringing ETF net assets to $1.43 billion' is contradicted: XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of outflows on Nov 9 and net assets near $1.24B. 'XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts' overstates a draft roadmap design that is not live. 'Senator Van Hollen will not vote for the CLARITY Act' is not new: he opposed it in May and voted no on Sept 15. 'Former Goldman Sachs analyst warns $0.30 is next' names no one. 'A newly activated wallet received $167.7 million of XRP' gives no transaction or source. 'Ripple's founder dumped nearly all his XRP' posts misstate a real disclosure: David Schwartz is a former CTO and XRP Ledger co-architect, not Ripple's founder, and says he still holds about 3M XRP plus Ripple stock. 'Kazakhstan's central bank invested $100 million in crypto funds, including XRP' is half right: the roughly $100M fund allocation is reported (Bloomberg via crypto.news), but no report names XRP. 'Brad Garlinghouse says long-term XRP holders will be very happy, something big may be coming' gives no date, video or source. 'A valuation report says 500 XRP could be worth $1.1 million by 2028' names no report, implies about $2,200 per XRP, and is attached to a token promotion. '$280 million of certified diamonds tokenized on XRP' is recycled from February. 'A former SWIFT engineer predicts a $100 to $250 XRP repricing in 2027' names no engineer and gives no basis; it is a prediction, not news. 'Ripple Mint launches' posts dated this week recycle a July 23, 2026 Ripple announcement. 'Global reset' and 'XRP reset' posts are wrong about the main ledger: the only reset scheduled is for the XRPL Testnet and Devnet developer networks on Nov 25, and real XRP on mainnet is not affected. 'Raymond James disclosed XRP ETF holdings in its 13F' is unverified: no outlet reports it and the 13F summaries we checked do not show an XRP ETF position. 'Trump just mentioned XRP on live television' clips name no program; the only November TV interview we found is his 60 Minutes interview, and no outlet reports an XRP mention. 'Bitwise just bought $13.25M of XRP' misdescribes ETF flows: Bitwise the firm does not buy for itself, its XRP ETF showed no net flow on Nov 12, and the group had a $1.09M outflow on Nov 13. 'The Department of Energy is building XRP Ledger apps for energy trades' is reported only by crypto outlets citing unnamed 'details of the federal initiative'; we found no DOE announcement. 'RLUSD just flipped XRP' is false: RLUSD is about $2.8B in market value versus about $63B for XRP. 'An unknown entity now holds $2.77 billion of XRP, the 8th-largest account' recycles a Sept 26 post made when XRP was about $1.54; at today's price that wallet's roughly 1.8B XRP is worth about $1.7B, and the XRPSonar tracker labels the address as Robinhood (not confirmed by Robinhood). 'Robinhood just picked the XRP Ledger, this could change everything' video teasers repackage the Oct 27 Ripple-Robinhood partnership; RLUSD settlement on the XRPL is planned with no start date. 'How much longer until $100 XRP? The question isn't if, it's when' is hype with no basis; XRP is under $1. 'Trump just mentioned XRP on live television' and 'Bitwise just bought $13.25M of XRP' posts were reposted again this weekend with no new evidence. Details are in the rumors section.
legend: Published by Ripple, a partner company, or a regulator about itself.
General financial press such as Reuters or Bloomberg.
Established crypto newsrooms such as CoinDesk, The Block, CryptoSlate.
Commentators, influencers and post summaries on X, blogs or video.
A claim of fact or future event with no named source.
Primary document, or a newsroom report with named sources or data.
Credible outlet relaying third-party data or company plans not yet delivered.
Partly true, but the conclusion drawn goes beyond the evidence.
No corroboration found. Treat as opinion.
Available evidence points the other way.

news.headline: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
news.summary: XRP hit 89 cents; down 36% this quarter; US XRP ETFs had $19.13M of net outflows last week, the most since March (SoSoValue).

news.headline: Bitcoin drifts back to $65,000, 'deep value zone' says analyst
news.summary: Bitcoin fell about 8% after Friday's US close, touching a three-month low just above $62,000; down 17% over the week. 'Deep value' is one analyst's opinion.

news.headline: Bitcoin falls below $64,000 as ETF outflows extend to seventh straight day
news.summary: Low of $63,403, weakest since August; spot bitcoin ETFs −$185M Friday, about $1.91B out since Nov 5 (SoSoValue); $1.47B liquidated in 24 hours (CoinGlass).

news.headline: XRP falls 10% in rout
news.summary: XRP at $0.9111 Saturday afternoon ET, down 10.13% on the day, its largest one-day percentage loss since Feb 5; 7-day range $0.91 to $1.17.

news.headline: Why is XRP crashing below $1?
news.summary: Cites bitcoin's slide, 88.7% odds of a December Fed hike, a 5.15% 10-year yield and $1.23B of liquidations; found no Ripple-specific news behind the drop.

news.headline: XRP price tests key support as ETF and futures pressure builds
news.summary: Ten straight down days; XRP futures open interest at a multi-month low of $2.21B; Fear and Greed Index at 18. Chart levels such as $0.90 are opinion.

news.headline: XRP sinks below $1 to its lowest since 2024 as XRP ETFs turn one
news.summary: US spot XRP ETFs hold about 1.16B to 1.19B XRP a year after launch; no net inflows since Oct 29 and about $18.6M out in November (SoSoValue).

news.headline: Bitcoin ETFs lose $2.35B as BlackRock outflows hit 11 sessions
news.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs shed $1.07B this week after $1.28B the week before, the largest weekly redemptions since late June (Farside).

news.headline: Ripple plans Nov. 25 reset of XRP Ledger Testnet and Devnet
news.summary: One-hour reset 8 to 9 p.m. ET Nov 25 after a server failure; mainnet records, XRP balances and real tokens are untouched.

news.headline: XRP price falls below $1 to lowest since August as analyst warns of $0.80 drop
news.summary: XRP at about $0.993 early Saturday UTC, near its 2026 low of about $0.986 set Aug 14; it did not close below $1 on Friday. The $0.80 level is one analyst's view.

news.headline: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as dollar surges and $1.6 billion liquidated
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether hit 12-week lows as the Dollar Index topped 103 and CME FedWatch priced about 88% odds of a December hike; $1.64B liquidated, mostly longs; XRP funding slightly negative.

news.headline: Bitcoin tumbles below $69,000 as Nvidia turmoil adds to Fed-driven market jitters
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 7% in 24 hours to its lowest since Aug 20; XRP lost 3.5%; $1.47B liquidated, $1.31B of it longs (CoinGlass).

news.headline: U.S. XRP ETFs post $1.09 million net outflow on Nov. 13
news.summary: Franklin's XRPZ +$4.45M, Grayscale's GXRP −$5.54M; cumulative net inflows $1.789B, net assets $1.152B.

news.headline: XRP crashes toward $0.99 as analyst warns of another brutal drop
news.summary: XRP briefly fell below $1 Friday for the first time since August (low about $0.9967) before recovering near $1.02; analyst Ali Charts names $0.99 support and $0.80 below. Opinion, not a forecast.

news.headline: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 networks, plans full restoration before next weekend
news.summary: LTC and NEAR among restored assets; remaining services targeted before next weekend.

news.headline: XRP Ledger AI services exceed 5,400 across more than 190 merchants
news.summary: t54's XRPL AI Hub lists 193 merchants and 5,410 services payable in XRP or RLUSD; about $78,000 in total settled value so far, which is small.

claims.claim: JUST IN: An UNKNOWN ENTITY now holds $2,770,000,000 worth of $XRP, making it the 8TH-LARGEST XRP account in the WORLD.
claims.check: Recycled: the same poster made this claim on Sept 26, when XRP was about $1.54 (Times Tabloid). The wallet holds about 1.8B XRP, worth about $1.7B at today's $0.96, not $2.77B. The XRPSonar tracker labels the address as Robinhood; that label is not confirmed by Robinhood. A large balance can be custody for many clients. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: Times Tabloid: This mystery wallet is the 8th-largest XRP account (Sept 28)

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP crashes under $0.95 for the first time since November 2024.
claims.who: @OliverSmitvnfv and many copies on X (via @WatcherGuru), Nov 14-15
claims.check: Accurate: XRP fell as low as about $0.89 on Saturday, its lowest since November 2024 (CoinDesk), and closed about $0.91. It has since bounced to about $0.96.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto

claims.claim: JUST IN: Robinhood Just Picked The XRP Ledger... XRP HOLDERS, This Could Change EVERYTHING
claims.check: Not new: it repackages the Oct 27 Ripple-Robinhood partnership. Robinhood plans to use the RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement via Bitstamp, with no start date or volume announced. That is a plan involving RLUSD, not an XRP purchase. 'Change everything' is hype.
claims.check_title: Ripple: Ripple and Robinhood partner to power the next generation of finance (Oct 27)

claims.claim: JUST IN: How much longer until $100 $XRP? The question isn't if... It's when. Clock's ticking.
claims.check: A price wish presented as news, with no source or basis. XRP is about $0.96 and its all-time high is about $3.65 (July 2025). No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: JUST IN: TRUMP JUST MENTIONED XRP ON LIVE TELEVISION
claims.who: @DigPerspView, @THE17THLETgxm and many identical copies on X, Nov 13-15
claims.check: Reposted again overnight with no new evidence. The posts name no program, date or quote. The only November TV interview we found is Trump's 60 Minutes interview, which covered his family's crypto business; no outlet reports him mentioning XRP. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: CBS News: Extended interview: President Trump on 60 Minutes

claims.claim: JUST IN: $10B asset manager Bitwise just bought more than $13,250,000 worth of $XRP.
claims.check: Still circulating and still misleading: Bitwise the firm does not buy XRP for itself; its ETF buys when investors add money. SoSoValue data shows no net flow for the Bitwise XRP ETF on Nov 12, and the group had net outflows of $1.09M on Nov 13 and $19.1M for the week (CoinDesk). No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: U.S. XRP ETFs post $1.09 million net outflow on Nov. 13

claims.claim: U.S. Department of Energy Bets on XRP Ledger for Blockchain-Based Energy Market Settlements
claims.who: @MackAttackXRP on X, sharing ZyCrypto (also TokenPost), Nov 13-14
claims.check: Reported only by crypto outlets citing unnamed 'details of the federal initiative'. We found no DOE press release, contract or document and no mainstream coverage. Even if real, a development project does not show XRP demand.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: U.S. Department of Energy develops XRP Ledger applications for energy trades

claims.claim: CHARLIE WARD - THE GLOBAL RESET - WHITE HATS IN CONTROL - TRUST THE PLAN #XRP #XRPL #Reset
claims.check: The only reset scheduled is for the XRPL Testnet and Devnet developer networks on Nov 25, after a server failure. Mainnet and real XRP balances are not affected, and holders need to do nothing. Anyone asking you to 'move' or 'verify' XRP for a reset fits a common scam pattern.
claims.check_title: The Crypto Basic: XRPL validator says the only 'XRP reset' coming is for Testnet and Devnet

claims.claim: JUST IN: A $1.94 TRILLION financial giant is now on the XRP ETF holders list. Raymond James Financial has disclosed XRP ETF holdings in its latest SEC 13F filing.
claims.check: No outlet reports it, and the summaries of Raymond James's Q3 2026 13F (filed Nov 12, holdings as of Sept 30) that we checked do not show an XRP ETF position. Even if a small position exists, a 13F often reflects client accounts at a broker, not a firm bet.

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP Ledger lending protocol reaches 22/29 validator votes, up 3 in 3 weeks. SingleAssetVault hits 23.
claims.check: Accurate: CoinDesk reports 22 votes (of 35 validators; 29 needed for two straight weeks), SingleAssetVault at 23. Posts saying banks 'could soon' lend on XRPL skip that it is not live and has no date.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Ripple's bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
